summary: SAP SE filed a Form 6-K announcing its invitation to the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for May 5, 2026, as a virtual meeting. The agenda includes standard items such as approval of financial statements, appropriation of retained earnings, ratification of management acts, appointment of auditors, and approval of the compensation report. There are no special situation events like acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. This is a routine AGM notice.
